paragraphs.en: We rushed across the wooden strip towards the stockade as the pirates' voices grew louder. Their footsteps and the snapping of branches signaled their approach.
paragraphs.zh: 我们急忙穿过木板小径，向栅栏冲去，海盗的声音越来越响。他们的脚步声和树枝断裂的声音预示着他们即将来临。

paragraphs.en: I noticed we were in for a serious confrontation and checked my priming. "Captain," I said, "Trelawney is an excellent shot; give him your gun." We exchanged weapons, and Trelawney, silent as always, ensured his was ready.
paragraphs.zh: 我意识到我们将面临一场严重的对峙，便检查了一下自己的装弹情况。“船长，”我说，“特拉韦尼是个神枪手；把你的枪给他。”我们交换了武器，特拉韦尼一如既往地沉默着，确保自己的枪已经上膛。

paragraphs.en: Seeing Gray unarmed, I handed him my cutlass. He tested the blade, his body tense with determination. Clearly, he was a capable addition to our group.
paragraphs.zh: 见到格雷赤手空拳，我递给他我的短剑。他试了试刀锋，身体紧绷，充满决心。显然，他是个能力出众的伙伴。

paragraphs.en: We reached the edge of the wood and spotted the stockade ahead. We entered the enclosure near the middle of the south side just as seven mutineers, led by Job Anderson, appeared at the southwestern corner.
paragraphs.zh: 我们来到树林边缘，发现前方有一个木栅。就在南侧中部的位置，我们刚进入栅栏内，就看见七名叛乱者出现在西南角，为首的是乔布·安德森。

paragraphs.en: The pirates paused, taken aback. Before they could react, the squire and I, along with Hunter and Joyce from the blockhouse, fired our shots. Four scattered volleys hit their mark; one pirate fell dead, and the others fled into the trees.
paragraphs.zh: 海盗们愣了一下，还没来得及反应，我、侍从以及瞭望塔上的亨特和乔西便开起了火。四声零散的枪响过后，一名海盗应声倒地，其余的则慌忙逃入了树林。

paragraphs.en: After reloading, we checked on the fallen pirate. He was indeed dead, shot through the heart.
paragraphs.zh: 重新装填弹药后，我们上前查看那位倒下的海盗。他确实已经死去，心脏中弹。

paragraphs.en: Our spirits lifted at this success until a pistol crack echoed in the bushes. A bullet whizzed past my ear, and poor Tom Redruth stumbled and fell. The squire and I returned fire but missed our targets, likely wasting powder.
paragraphs.zh: 我们见状顿时士气大增，但就在这时，灌木丛中传来一声枪响。一颗子弹从我耳边呼啸而过，可怜的汤姆·雷德鲁特应声踉跄了一下，摔倒在地。乡绅和我急忙还击，却未能命中目标，恐怕只是白白浪费了火药。

paragraphs.en: We reloaded and turned to help Tom. Captain and Gray were already examining him, and it was clear he was beyond help.
paragraphs.zh: 我们重新装填好武器，转向去帮助汤姆。船长和格雷已经上前检查他了，显然他已经无法救治了。

paragraphs.en: The pirates seemed scattered by our quick response. We managed to lift the old gamekeeper over the stockade and carry him into the log-house, where he groaned in pain and bled.
paragraphs.zh: 海盗们似乎被我们迅速的反应打乱了阵脚。我们好不容易将那位老看守抬过栅栏，送进了木屋里，他痛得直呻吟，鲜血直流。

paragraphs.en: The old man lay silently in the log-house, having shown no emotion throughout their troubles until now. He had remained steadfast and obedient, despite his age and service.
paragraphs.zh: 老人静静地躺在木屋里，直到此刻才表现出丝毫情感。尽管年事已高且为家庭奉献了多年，他始终坚定而顺从。

paragraphs.en: The squire knelt beside him, kissing his hand as he wept like a child. "Are you going, doctor?" he asked.
paragraphs.zh: 管家跪在他身旁，一边哭泣一边吻他的手。“医生，你要走吗？”他问道。

paragraphs.en: "Tom, my man," I said, "you're going home."
paragraphs.zh: “汤姆，我的伙计，”我说，“你回家去吧。”

paragraphs.en: "I wish I had shot them first with the gun," Tom replied.
paragraphs.zh: “要是我先用枪打中他们就好了，”汤姆说道。

paragraphs.en: "Tom," the squire said, "will you forgive me?"
paragraphs.zh: “汤姆，”庄园主说道，“你能原谅我吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Respectfully, yes," Tom answered. After a moment of silence, he requested someone read a prayer, saying it was customary.
paragraphs.zh: 汤姆恭敬地回答：“是的。”片刻沉默后，他请求有人读一段祷词，说这是惯例。

paragraphs.en: The captain, swollen and laden with supplies, emerged from his hiding place. He distributed items like British colours, a Bible, rope, tobacco, and a fir tree to erect as a flagpole at the log-house corner. He then raised the flag himself, visibly relieved.
paragraphs.zh: 船长肿胀且满载物资，从藏身之处走了出来。他分发着英国国旗、《圣经》、绳索、烟草以及一棵松树作为旗杆，在木屋的角落竖立起来。随后，他自己升起了旗帜，显得如释重负。

paragraphs.en: Inside, the captain began counting stores, keeping an eye on Tom's passing. Once done, he reverently placed another flag over the body, assuring the squire that all was well for Tom who had died in his duty.
paragraphs.zh: Inside，船长开始清点物资，并留意着汤姆的动静。完成后，他庄重地在尸体上覆盖了一面新的旗帜，向那位绅士保证，汤姆是在尽职尽责中去世的，一切安好。

paragraphs.en: "Dr. Livesey," the captain said, "how many weeks do you and the squire expect to be rescued?"
paragraphs.zh: 船长问道：“利维斯医生，你们和庄园主预计还要多久会被救走？”

paragraphs.en: I explained it would take months, not weeks, with Blandly sending a search party by August if we weren't back by then.
paragraphs.zh: 我解释说这需要几个月时间，而不是几周。如果到八月我们还没有回来，B兰德利会派遣搜救队。

paragraphs.en: The captain scratched his head and replied, "Yes, and considering the gifts of Providence, we are quite close hauled." He continued, "We lost that second load, so powder and shot will do, but rations are short—so short, Dr. Livesey, that perhaps it's better without an extra mouth."
paragraphs.zh: 船长挠了挠头，回答说：“是的，而且考虑到天赐之物，我们已经很接近目标了。”他又说道：“那第二批货物我们没保住，所以火药和炮弹可以凑合，但食物短缺——短缺到，莱维斯医生，恐怕最好还是不要多一个人的口粮。”

paragraphs.en: He pointed to a dead body under the flag. Suddenly, a round-shot whizzed over the log-house roof and landed far in the woods.
paragraphs.zh: 他指着旗杆下的一具尸体。就在这时，一颗炮弹呼啸着飞过木屋的屋顶，在树林深处爆炸开来。

paragraphs.en: "Blaze away!" said the captain. "You have little enough powder already, my lads."
paragraphs.zh: “开火吧！”船长喊道，“你们已经不多剩多少炮弹了，伙计们。”

paragraphs.en: During the second trial, the aim was better; the ball hit inside the stockade, scattering sand but causing no further damage.
paragraphs.zh: 在第二次审理中，效果有所提升；球击中了栅栏内部，虽然扬起了沙土，却没有造成更大的破坏。

paragraphs.en: The squire suggested, "Captain, the house is invisible from the ship. They must be aiming at the flag. Should we take it down?"
paragraphs.zh: 管家建议道：“船长，这座房子从船上是看不见的。他们一定是瞄准了旗杆。我们应该把它降下来吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Strike my colours!" cried the captain. "No, sir, not I."
paragraphs.zh: “缴械！”船长喊道，“不，先生，不会是我。”

paragraphs.en: We all agreed with him; it was good policy to show our enemies that we despised their cannonade.
paragraphs.zh: 我们一致赞同他的观点，向敌人展示我们轻视他们的炮击才是明智之举。

paragraphs.en: Throughout the evening, they kept firing. Balls flew over or fell short, kicking up sand in the enclosure. The shots had to be fired so high that they buried themselves in soft sand, posing no ricochet threat.
paragraphs.zh: 整个晚上，他们不停地射击。子弹要么飞过靶标，要么射得不够高，溅起沙子落在围栏内。为了确保安全，他们不得不将子弹发射得很高，深深埋入柔软的沙中，不会造成弹片威胁。

paragraphs.en: One ball popped through the roof and out again, but we soon got used to it.
paragraphs.zh: 一个气球穿过屋顶飞了出去，不过我们很快就习惯了这种状况。

paragraphs.en: The captain observed, "There is one good thing about all this—the wood in front of us is likely clear. The ebb has made our stores uncovered. Volunteers to go and bring in pork."
paragraphs.zh: 船长观察了一下，说道：“虽然情况有些棘手，但有一件好事——我们面前的木头应该没有敌人的埋伏。退潮让我们储存的食物暴露在外了。谁愿意去把猪肉搬上来？”

paragraphs.en: Gray and Hunter led the way out of the stockade. Armed but unsuccessful, they found mutineers more daring than expected, carrying off supplies with ease. Silver commanded from the stern, each man armed.
paragraphs.zh: 格雷和亨特率先走出木栅。虽然手持武器，但未能成功，他们发现叛乱者比预期更加大胆，轻易地携走了物资。银则在船尾指挥，每个人手里都握着武器。

paragraphs.en: The captain began his log entry: Alexander Smollett was master; David Livesey, ship's doctor; Abraham Gray, carpenter’s mate; John Trelawney, owner; and John Hunter and Richard Joyce, servants—these were the loyal crew members left. They had stores for ten days at short rations and raised British colors on a log house.
paragraphs.zh: 船长开始了航海日志的记录：亚历山大·斯莫莱特担任船长；大卫·利维塞是船医；亚伯拉罕·格雷是木匠助手；约翰·特拉威尼是船主；而约翰·亨特和理查德·乔伊斯则是仆人——这些人是留下的忠诚船员。他们储备了十天的物资，每人定量供应，并在一块木头搭建的小屋上升起了英国国旗。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, I pondered Jim Hawkins' fate.
paragraphs.zh: Meanwhile，我思索着吉姆·霍金斯的境遇。

paragraphs.en: A voice called from outside.
paragraphs.zh: 外面有人喊了一声。

paragraphs.en: "Someone is calling us," said Hunter, on guard.
paragraphs.zh: “有人在叫我们,”亨特警惕地说道。

paragraphs.en: "Doctor! Squire! Captain!
paragraphs.zh: “医生！乡绅！船长！

paragraphs.en: Hullo, Hunter, is that you?" came the cries.
paragraphs.zh: “哈喽，霍恩特，是你吗？”叫声传来。

paragraphs.en: I rushed to the door just in time to see Jim Hawkins climbing over the stockade, safe and sound.
paragraphs.zh: 我赶忙跑到门口，正好看到吉姆·霍金斯安全地翻过了栅栏。
